purpose: Teach: フレッツ/エンタテイメント/ラストシーン/ポッドキャスティング/ヤンキース/ソフトボール/ホステス/タッグ
target_vocab: ポッドキャスティング

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ご自宅でフレッツ光のお話を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer told you about Flets fiber at their home, didn't they.
lines.style: Soft, almost wondering. Turning a small memory over in her mind. Gentle landing on the period—not quite a question, but leaving space for Aoi's response.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、エンタテイメント業界のお仕事だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer works in entertainment, didn't they say.
lines.style: Quiet observation, matching Mei's rhythm. Noticing the pattern without pushing it. A small smile in the voice—the recognition of someone being interesting.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、映画のラストシーンを語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: They told you about the ending of a film, remember.
lines.style: Soft wonder. Almost to herself first, then inviting Aoi in. The kind of listening that notices what matters to people.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ポッドキャスティング配信をされてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer does podcast distribution, didn't you mention.
lines.style: Still tracking, still present. Low, steady tone. The voice of someone genuinely keeping up with the threads of a conversation.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ヤンキースの試合を観に行かれたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: They went to see the Yankees play, didn't they.
lines.style: A little brighter now—noticing the texture of a life being shared. Warmth underneath. The voice relaxing slightly into the conversation.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お子様がソフトボールチームに入られたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Their child joined a softball team, you said.
lines.style: Soft delight in the detail. The voice settling deeper—Mei noticing what Aoi has noticed. Genuine care in the rhythm.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ホステス文学の本を読んでらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: They were reading that book about hostess culture.
lines.style: Quiet recognition. The kind of observation that says I see you noticing. Reflective, almost conversational with herself—then sharing it with Aoi.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お友達とタッグを組んで起業されたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: They partnered with a friend to start their own business.
lines.style: Warmth closing inward. The observation landing softly. A small pause before the end—letting the significance settle. Tender, genuine recognition.
